title: Technoblade Never Dies! splash text
description: Adds the "Technoblade Never Dies!" splash text to the game
body:
This is a very simple Minecraft resource pack made as a tribute to Technoblade.

The pack replaces the default Minecraft splash text with:

“Technoblade Never Dies!”

That’s it. No gameplay changes, no texture changes, no sounds, no performance impact. Just a small splash text tribute for anyone who wants to keep the phrase alive on their Minecraft title screen.

This is a fan-made tribute resource pack and is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft, or Technoblade’s official team.
